issues.issue: Search excerpts were previously mistaken for complete browsing
issues.resolution: Added official-SDK native MCP open/find/click with actual fetch hashes, public HTTPS, cold references, explicit cancellation and native-lifetime comparison.

issues.issue: Initial 64-method list mixed local operations and hosted-backend contracts
issues.resolution: 60 local positive operations individually verified; 4 hosted Apps/remote-plugin boundaries corrected and separately checked. Five OS-verification methods also require an account identity in upstream and were compared at their unavailable-account gate.

issues.issue: Incomplete response history was interpreted as assistant prefill or rejected
issues.resolution: Retain exact output in labeled nonexecuting context; select compatible context route before request; native retry recovered in fault-injection tests.

issues.issue: Provider could publish Markdown instead of strict JSON
issues.resolution: Validate final schema locally before message completion. Invalid values are never repaired or coerced into success; native retry recovered after a controlled fault.

issues.issue: Supervisor startup could race worker SQLite schema creation
issues.resolution: Unknown ownership conservatively retains service. Deterministic delayed-schema real-process and corrupt-database tests pass.

issues.issue: Parent final prose omitted a completed child answer
issues.resolution: Native completion and exact parent-context delivery are mandatory. Parent summarization is a separate model-quality metric; both fork modes revalidated. Original failure retained.

issues.issue: One generation metadata lookup unavailable after completed request
issues.resolution: Original route proof remains failed; unchanged route verifier rerun established all provider generation receipts.

issues.issue: Real HTTPcore independent TCP stress exposed an ownership race after cancellation fix
issues.resolution: Saved native task resumed with explicit acceptance feedback, production code and deterministic regression repaired, reviewer repeated, full suites plus three stress runs and TLS checks passed.

issues.issue: Browser private-IP guard rejected macOS VPN Fake-IP DNS
issues.resolution: Hostname-only exception requires a matching kernel TUN route in benchmark IP range; literal private/reserved destinations remain blocked. Public HTTPS verified.
